info.title: SkillsMP API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the SkillsMP REST API. The MCP server at /mcp uses a separate access and rate-limit policy. Search 2M+ Agent Skills by keyword, filter by category, occupation, and content language.

get.description: Search Agent Skills by keyword with optional filtering by category, occupation, and content language. Anonymous REST access is configured for 50 requests/day and 10/minute; authenticated REST access is configured for 500 requests/day and 30/minute. These limits do not apply to the MCP server.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Requests beyond the queryable result window are canonicalized to its final page.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category slug (e.g. data-ai, devops)

parameters.name: occupation
parameters.description: Filter by SOC occupation slug (e.g. software-developers)

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Filter by detected Skill content language. Use an ISO language code such as en, zh, or ja; mul selects mixed-language content and und selects content whose language could not be determined.

total.description: Exact matching result count when totalIsExact is true; otherwise a proven lower bound within the queryable result window.

totalPages.description: Exact page count when totalIsExact is true or isCapped is true; otherwise the currently proven page horizon. Follow hasNext to traverse inexact searches.

hasNext.description: Whether another queryable result page is known to exist. Use this field to traverse inexact searches.

hasPrev.description: Whether a previous result page exists.

totalIsExact.description: Whether total and totalPages describe the complete matching result set.

isCapped.description: Whether pagination is limited to maxResults even though more matches may exist.

maxResults.description: Maximum queryable result count when isCapped is true.

X-RateLimit-Minute-Remaining.description: Remaining requests in the current minute window

400.description: Bad request - missing query or invalid query, page, limit, occupation, or language. Correct the parameters before retrying; unchanged requests should not be retried automatically.

429.description: REST search limit exceeded. DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED resets at 00:00 UTC. RATE_LIMITED indicates the minute limit. Both return Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset for the earliest permitted retry; if the attempt also exhausted the daily quota, wait for the daily reset. Request attempts, including invalid parameters and minute-limit rejections, consume daily quota.

X-RateLimit-Daily-Limit.description: Daily request limit for this account or anonymous client

X-RateLimit-Daily-Remaining.description: Daily requests remaining after this attempt

X-RateLimit-Minute-Limit.description: Present when the minute window is exhausted

X-RateLimit-Minute-Remaining.description: Present when the minute window is exhausted

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the quota window resets. Present for both daily and minute limits. Wait at least this long before retrying; another request sharing the quota may consume the renewed capacity.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for the quota reset used by Retry-After

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Limit of the quota window that determines the retry time

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Remaining capacity in the quota window that determines the retry time

503.description: Search index or rate-limit coordination temporarily unavailable. Retry the request after the indicated delay.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents caches from storing the transient error response.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying.

error.message: API rate-limit coordination is temporarily unavailable.

contentLanguage.description: Detected language of the Skill content. ISO language codes identify a language, mul means mixed-language content, und means the detector could not determine a language, and null means language metadata is unavailable.

bearerAuth.description: API key obtained from the developer portal
